strings.en: Successfully escort  Ho-Ho-Tron's dolyak to the gate in Divinity's Reach.

"Commfinder,"

Harvest Den is beginning to bustle again at the end of this year's torpor. Yet here I am with a Poky-approved pile of letters and documents so Paw knows what he needs to read, stamp, and sign for the alliance. It can be tedious, but if I am to be Claw one day, part of the job it is.

Still, I'd do just about anything to be off on an adventure with you and the others again. Heard, I have, that you've taken to warmer waters in the meantime, and I hope that means your longtime friends have convinced you to kick up your paws and take it slow.

With that pondered, if you were to spend some of your downtime with us lowlanders, it'd be a real boon—especially for the cubs. Keep asking, they do, if you'll come back to regale them with the tales of your Janthir adventures. If you have the time, find me at my usual post in Harvest Den.

Your pal,
—Poised Arrow, Ambassador of Harvest Den

PS. Alliance gatherings haven't been so bad. There was a human named Dougal, I think? Showed me the best places to sneak off for a quick nap. Swell guy.

Gixx—I'm glad your tour of our library and archive was beneficial! It's a joy bringing more curious eyes into our halls.  
  
I prodded the ol' curator into giving me a little more information on the Foundry of Failed Creations, per your request. He was a little shy about sharing too much detail, but I have confirmed a few of your thoughts: so long as the soul flame at the pit of the foundry is still lit, new titans can still be forged. Given our visitors, Isgarren assumes that the foundry has either remained active or was recently relit. Certainly, the exterior realms are brimming with souls following the dragon cycle and Kryptis... But perhaps we'll focus on the foundry while you focus on the titans.   
  
Please let me know if you need anything else.   
  
—Lyhr
